correctness.rationale: Independent enumeration as all partial injective neighbor maps on the eight cube vertices, rejecting directed cycles, gives exactly 6496 nonempty multipath faces with f-vector (24,216,928,2016,2160,1008,144). Independent reproduction of the explicit 24-arc toggle order gives 3196 disjoint Morse pairs and critical counts (1,0,0,7,47,37,12) in dimensions 0..6; topological sort of all 6496 cells/29136 oriented incidences establishes global acyclicity. An independently formed exact integer Morse boundary has only ∂4 and ∂5 nonzero, each rank1 with Smith invariant (1), and ∂6=0; chain composition is zero. Thus torsion-free reduced H3=Z6,H4=Z45,H5=Z36,H6=Z12. The critical CW model has one vertex and no critical 1- or 2-cells, so it is 2-connected and Hurewicz gives pi3=Z6. This does NOT claim full homotopy equivalence to a wedge.
residual_risks: No general formula for larger bidirected hypercubes follows from this finite exact Q3 computation.
Integral homology and pi3 do not establish higher attaching maps or a global wedge decomposition.

value.rationale: The three-cube is the smallest natural higher-dimensional hypercube with multiple intersecting directed cycles and three outgoing directions, a structural boundary beyond bidirected path/polygon cases. Its four consecutive torsion-free homology degrees and 2-connectivity are exact benchmark invariants needed for comparison with possible cubical product formulas.
